svg.text: Roamyboard key modules: parts of the joint
Drawn from the r5 model numbers (case/roamy-v4). Module frame: x across the column from the socket face, y along it from the SW1 end face, z up from the board's back.
1 Top view of a pair (looking down at the keys)
the module on its header side.
2 Detail: SW1 end of the seam, cut through the guide pin (top view, B's frame)
The slit (0.3 mm) separates the flap from the wall above and below the guide hole and runs through the top and rim;
at this height the guide hole itself separates them. The pin's 45° gables (top and bottom) are out of this cut.
3 Section at a connector row, looking from the SW1 end (x right, z up)
slide-on: B moves along its own board plane
tilted 8° about its pads' inboard end
Dotted grey: the socket and header faces run radially to the joint centre, 149 mm below the board; that outline (a keystone) is why neighbours' tops and rims meet.
